title: Contact cases: short discharge note with next of kin (English)

pages.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FAKE DATA ONLY
Testville General Hospital (FAKE) - Short Stay Unit
500 Sample Avenue, Testville ON Z9Z 9Z9 · Tel 613-555-0110

DISCHARGE NOTE

Patient: FAKE-BRENNAN, Leo             Health card: 1234 567 891 (FAKE)
Date of birth: 9 February 1952          MRN: TGH-0081234
Admitted: 2 November 2026               Discharged: 5 November 2026
Next of kin: Maria FAKE-Brennan (daughter), 613-555-0172, maria.brennan@example.org
Home address: 18 Fictional Crescent, Testville ON Z9Z 1A1

Reason for admission: cellulitis of the left lower leg.

Hospital course: Treated with intravenous cefazolin for 2 days, then switched to oral cephalexin.
The redness has shrunk inside the pen line drawn on admission, and the fever settled on
3 November. Blood cultures showed no growth.

Medications at discharge:
- Cephalexin 500 mg by mouth four times a day for 7 more days (last dose 12 November 2026).
- Continue your usual metformin 500 mg twice a day.

Instructions for the patient:
- Keep the left leg raised when sitting.
- If the redness spreads past the pen line, or you get a fever over 38 °C, call the Short Stay Unit at 613-555-0150, day or night.
- See your family doctor in 1 week (by 12 November 2026) to check the leg.

Copy to: Dr. Ann FAKE-Okafor, family physician, Fax 613-555-0119
Electronically signed: Dr. Sam Placeholder, MD (FAKE)
